algorithm_title: Implement a Stack using an Array (push/pop/peek)
evidence_summary: This suite provides partial behavioural evidence using one predefined common behavioural test, with partial state-mutation evidence. The embedded sequence covers push, peek, pop and empty-stack attempts; alternative capacities/values are fixed.
coverage_basis: Assessment is based on the predefined common behavioural test, the behaviours exposed by the frozen program interface, and the declared coverage dimensions: state mutation.
interpretation_guidance: Interpret behavioural accuracy as useful but incomplete evidence across the declared exercised behaviours; unexercised behaviours remain outside the direct evidence.
coverage_limitations: The embedded sequence covers push, peek, pop and empty-stack attempts; alternative capacities/values are fixed.
